name: mssql
description: An asynchronous, runtime-independent, pure-Rust Tabular Data Stream (TDS) client for Microsoft SQL Server. A fork of Tiberius, focused on ongoing maintenance and security updates via small, targeted changes.

exports.Client: The async TDS connection. `Client::connect(config, stream)`, then `.query()`, `.execute()`, `.bulk_insert()`, `.call_procedure()`.
exports.Config: Connection configuration: host, port, authentication, encryption; also parses ADO.NET and JDBC connection strings.
exports.ConfigBuilder: Fluent builder alternative to Config's setter methods.
exports.AuthMethod: SQL Server auth, or Windows/trusted (integrated) auth via `winauth`, `integrated-auth-gssapi`, or `sspi-rs`.
exports.Query: A parameterized statement: `.bind()` parameters, then `.query()` or `.execute()`.
exports.Row: One result row; `.get::<T>(idx)` reads a typed, nullable column value by position or name.
exports.Column: Metadata (name, type) for one column in a result set.
exports.ColumnType: Enum of the TDS wire column types.
exports.QueryIdx: Trait for indexing a Row by column name or position.
exports.FromSql: Trait: decode a borrowed column value into a Rust type.
exports.FromSqlOwned: Trait: decode an owned column value into a Rust type.
exports.ToSql: Trait: encode a Rust value as a bound query parameter.
exports.IntoSql: Trait: convert a value into its wire parameter representation.
exports.error: `pub mod error`; `error::Error` is the crate's single error type, covering I/O, TDS protocol, and server errors.
exports.QueryStream: The streaming result of a query; `.into_row()`, `.into_first_result()`, `.into_output_params()`, etc. consume it.
exports.ProcParam: One parameter to `Client::call_procedure`: `ProcParam::input(name, value)` or `ProcParam::output(name, value)` (the latter needs a concrete, non-NULL placeholder value to establish its SQL type).
exports.OutputParams: OUTPUT parameters and RETURN status from a stored-procedure call, read via `QueryStream::into_output_params`; `.get::<T>(name)` and `.return_status()`.
exports.SqlBulkCopyOption: One option controlling `Client::bulk_insert` (e.g. keep identity, table lock).
exports.SqlBrowser: Trait to resolve a SQL Server named instance's port via the UDP SQL Browser service.
exports.EncryptionLevel: TLS requirement level negotiated during login (off / on / required).
exports.time: TDS date/time types, with optional `chrono` and `time`-crate conversions.
exports.codec: Low-level TDS wire types for advanced use: ColumnData, TypeInfo, MetaDataColumn, BulkLoadRequest, TokenRow, IntoRow.
exports.Uuid: Re-exported `uuid::Uuid`, used for TDS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER columns.

feature_flags.all: Every optional feature below, for CI/testing.
feature_flags.tds73: TDS protocol version 7.3 support (on by default).
feature_flags.sql-browser-tokio: SQL Browser named-instance resolution over Tokio UDP.
feature_flags.sql-browser-async-std: SQL Browser named-instance resolution over async-std UDP.
feature_flags.sql-browser-smol: SQL Browser named-instance resolution over smol UDP.
feature_flags.winauth: Windows-native integrated authentication (default on Windows targets).
feature_flags.sspi-rs: Pure-Rust NTLM/SSPI integrated auth, without a real Kerberos ticket cache.
feature_flags.rustls: TLS via rustls instead of native-tls.
feature_flags.rustls-webpki-roots: Validate the server certificate against Mozilla's bundled root CA list instead of the OS trust store (implies rustls).
feature_flags.serde: Serialize/Deserialize for query result types (Row, Column, ColumnType, ColumnData, TokenRow, Numeric, time/xml types), for shipping results over the network as JSON.
